milestone: SeLinOS Linux syscall ABI M8 bounded mprotect/lseek/pread64 proof

contract.mprotect: Accept only mprotect(SELINOS_LINUX_MMAP_ADDRESS, 4096, PROT_READ|PROT_WRITE) for the existing isolated mapped page; return zero as an acknowledgement without changing mapping permissions.
contract.lseek: Accept only lseek(fd=5, offset=0, SEEK_SET) and return zero; it is a stateless no-op because the server has no cursor state.
contract.pread64: Accept only pread64(fd=5, mapped one-page buffer, count=8, offset=0); root reads existing volatile state through ROMFS IPC, copies exactly one word and returns eight.
contract.negative_scope: No arbitrary mprotect, page permission transition, unmap/remap, seek cursor, partial I/O, nonzero offset, immutable-FD pread or general file descriptor semantics are provided.

required_markers: SeLinOS ABI M8: mapped-page mprotect acknowledgement, zero-origin lseek and fixed-offset volatile pread64 mediated.
SeLinOS ABI M7: fixed volatile VFS open/read/write/read-back/close bridge mediated.
SeLinOS ABI M6: deterministic clock_gettime/getrlimit and non-blocking futex mismatch/wake mediated.
forbidden_markers: SeLinOS ABI gateway: bounded mprotect rejected.
SeLinOS ABI gateway: bounded lseek rejected.
SeLinOS ABI gateway: bounded volatile pread64 rejected.

not_claimed: page permission transition, mremap, munmap or general virtual memory management
stateful lseek cursor, nonzero seek offsets or general file positions
pread64 on arbitrary FDs, arbitrary offsets, partial I/O or multi-page buffers
TLS/ARCH_SET_FS, clone, blocking futexes, signals, ELF dynamic linking or general glibc ABI
persistent filesystem, network stack, package retrieval, dpkg or apt
